name: elementor-website-skill
title_zh: B2B 网站先过可信度关
tagline_zh: 给「看起来像外包」的官网治病的 AI 工作流：先审文案可信度，再生成能维护的 Elementor 组件。
tagline_en: Cure 'looks like outsourced' websites: audit copy credibility first, then build maintainable Elementor widgets—no.
desc_en: An AI-assisted workflow for designing credible B2B websites and building maintainable custom Elementor widgets. -
why_zh: 把「设计可信」和「代码可维护」拆成两道闸：先拦下空话套话，再产出结构清晰的 widget。
why_en: Two gates: kills fluffy claims before coding, then outputs clean widget structure. Forces AI to stay in its lane.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Elementor 生态，非 WordPress 站点用不上；产出物是组件代码与设计建议，不含部署上线。
limit_en: Elementor/WordPress only; outputs code + design advice, no deployment; requires your own AI toolchain setup.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: B2B site credibility check, then maintainable Elementor.
